proof.python:
import math
import statistics
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

from rstudioapi.as_document_range import as_document_range, document_range


def _num(value: float) -> str:
    if math.isnan(value):
        return "NA"
    return format(float(value), ".17g")


def line(name, fn, same=None):
    try:
        value = fn()
    except Exception as exc:
        text = "ERR " + str(exc)
    else:
        if hasattr(value, "start") and hasattr(value, "end"):
            s = value.start
            e = value.end
            text = (
                "OK "
                + _num(s.row)
                + " "
                + _num(s.column)
                + " "
                + _num(e.row)
                + " "
                + _num(e.column)
            )
            if same is not None:
                text += " " + ("TRUE" if value is same else "FALSE")
        else:
            text = "OTHER " + repr(value)
    return name + "=" + text


def one():
    rng = document_range((1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0))
    parts = [
        line("identity", lambda: as_document_range(rng), same=rng),
        line("dbl4", lambda: as_document_range((1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0))),
        line("int4", lambda: as_document_range((1, 2, 3, 4))),
        line("na4", lambda: as_document_range((float("nan"), 2.0, 3.0, 4.0))),
        line("vec2", lambda: as_document_range((1.0, 2.0))),
        line("len3", lambda: as_document_range((1.0, 2.0, 3.0))),
        line("logical", lambda: as_document_range((True, False, True, False))),
    ]
    return "\n".join(parts)


value = one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
shown = value.replace("\n", " / ")
print("VALUE " + shown)
print(f"MS {statistics.median(elapsed):.17g}")

stopifnot(identical(as.character(packageVersion("rstudioapi")), "0.19.0"))

line <- function(name, expr) {
  text <- tryCatch(
    {
      value <- expr
      if (isTRUE(value)) {
        "TRUE"
      } else if (identical(value, FALSE)) {
        "FALSE"
      } else {
        paste0("OTHER ", paste(as.character(value), collapse = ","))
      }
    },
    error = function(e) paste0("ERR ", conditionMessage(e))
  )
  paste0(name, "=", text)
}

restore <- function(name, previous) {
  if (is.na(previous)) {
    Sys.unsetenv(name)
  } else {
    do.call(Sys.setenv, setNames(list(previous), name))
  }
}

one <- function() {
  wb <- Sys.getenv("RSTUDIO_WORKBENCH_JOB", unset = NA_character_)

  rstudio <- Sys.getenv("RSTUDIO", unset = NA_character_)

    restore("RSTUDIO_WORKBENCH_JOB", wb)
    restore("RSTUDIOAPI_IPC_REQUESTS_FILE", ipc)
    restore("RSTUDIOAPI_IPC_RESPONSE_FILE", response)
    restore("RSTUDIOAPI_IPC_SHARED_SECRET", secret)
    restore("RSTUDIO", rstudio)
  }, add = TRUE)
  Sys.unsetenv("RSTUDIO_WORKBENCH_JOB")
  Sys.unsetenv("RSTUDIOAPI_IPC_REQUESTS_FILE")
  Sys.unsetenv("RSTUDIOAPI_IPC_RESPONSE_FILE")
  Sys.unsetenv("RSTUDIOAPI_IPC_SHARED_SECRET")
  Sys.unsetenv("RSTUDIO")

  parts <- c(
    line("default", isAvailable()),
    line("version", isAvailable(version_needed = "2024.04.2")),
    line("child", isAvailable(child_ok = TRUE)),
    line("both", isAvailable(version_needed = "0.99.0", child_ok = FALSE)),
    line("null", isAvailable(child_ok = NULL)),
    line("string", isAvailable(child_ok = "TRUE")),
    line("len2", isAvailable(child_ok = c(TRUE, FALSE))),
    line("zero", isAvailable(child_ok = 0)),
    line("one", isAvailable(child_ok = 1)),
    line("nan", isAvailable(child_ok = NaN)),
    line("empty", isAvailable(child_ok = logical(0))),
    line("zeroi", isAvailable(child_ok = 0i)),
    line("onei", isAvailable(child_ok = 1i))
  )
  Sys.setenv(RSTUDIO = "1")
  parts <- c(
    parts,
    line("rstudio-env", isAvailable()),
    line("rstudio-env-child", isAvailable(child_ok = TRUE))
  )
  Sys.unsetenv("RSTUDIO")
  Sys.setenv(RSTUDIO_WORKBENCH_JOB = "1")
  parts <- c(
    parts,
    line("wb-default", isAvailable()),
    line("wb-child", isAvailable(child_ok = TRUE)),
    line("wb-version", isAvailable(version_needed = "99.0", child_ok = TRUE)),
    line("wb-na", isAvailable(child_ok = NA)),
    line("wb-zeroi", isAvailable(child_ok = 0i)),
    line("wb-onei", isAvailable(child_ok = 1i))
  )
  Sys.unsetenv("RSTUDIO_WORKBENCH_JOB")
  Sys.setenv(RSTUDIOAPI_IPC_REQUESTS_FILE = "")
  parts <- c(
    parts,
    line("ipc-child", isAvailable(child_ok = TRUE)),
    line("ipc-false", isAvailable(child_ok = FALSE))
  )
  paste(parts, collapse = "\n")
}

value <- one()
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
  one()
  elapsed[[i]] <- as.numeric(Sys.time()) - t0
}
shown <- enc2utf8(paste(as.character(value), collapse = "|"))
shown <- gsub("\n", " / ", shown, fixed = TRUE)
cat("VALUE ", shown, "\n", sep = "")
cat(sprintf("MS %.17g\n", median(elapsed) * 1000))

import os
import statistics
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

from rstudioapi.is_available import isAvailable


def line(name, fn):
    try:
        value = fn()
    except Exception as exc:
        text = "ERR " + str(exc)
    else:
        if value is True:
            text = "TRUE"
        elif value is False:
            text = "FALSE"
        else:
            text = "OTHER " + repr(value)
    return name + "=" + text


def _restore(name, previous):
    if previous is None:
        os.environ.pop(name, None)
    else:
        os.environ[name] = previous


def one():
    saved = {
        name: os.environ.get(name)
        for name in (
            "RSTUDIO_WORKBENCH_JOB",
            "RSTUDIOAPI_IPC_REQUESTS_FILE",
            "RSTUDIOAPI_IPC_RESPONSE_FILE",
            "RSTUDIOAPI_IPC_SHARED_SECRET",
            "RSTUDIO",
        )
    }
    try:
        for name in saved:
            os.environ.pop(name, None)
        parts = [
            line("default", isAvailable),
            line("version", lambda: isAvailable(version_needed="2024.04.2")),
            line("child", lambda: isAvailable(child_ok=True)),
            line(
                "both",
                lambda: isAvailable(version_needed="0.99.0", child_ok=False),
            ),
            line("null", lambda: isAvailable(child_ok=None)),
            line("string", lambda: isAvailable(child_ok="TRUE")),
            line("len2", lambda: isAvailable(child_ok=(True, False))),
            line("zero", lambda: isAvailable(child_ok=0)),
            line("one", lambda: isAvailable(child_ok=1)),
            line("nan", lambda: isAvailable(child_ok=float("nan"))),
            line("empty", lambda: isAvailable(child_ok=())),
            line("zeroi", lambda: isAvailable(child_ok=0j)),
            line("onei", lambda: isAvailable(child_ok=1j)),
        ]
        os.environ["RSTUDIO"] = "1"
        parts.append(line("rstudio-env", isAvailable))
        parts.append(line("rstudio-env-child", lambda: isAvailable(child_ok=True)))
        os.environ.pop("RSTUDIO", None)
        os.environ["RSTUDIO_WORKBENCH_JOB"] = "1"
        parts.extend(
            [
                line("wb-default", isAvailable),
                line("wb-child", lambda: isAvailable(child_ok=True)),
                line(
                    "wb-version",
                    lambda: isAvailable(version_needed="99.0", child_ok=True),
                ),
                line("wb-na", lambda: isAvailable(child_ok=float("nan"))),
                line("wb-zeroi", lambda: isAvailable(child_ok=0j)),
                line("wb-onei", lambda: isAvailable(child_ok=1j)),
            ]
        )
        os.environ.pop("RSTUDIO_WORKBENCH_JOB", None)
        os.environ["RSTUDIOAPI_IPC_REQUESTS_FILE"] = ""
        parts.append(line("ipc-child", lambda: isAvailable(child_ok=True)))
        parts.append(line("ipc-false", lambda: isAvailable(child_ok=False)))
        return "\n".join(parts)
    finally:
        for name, previous in saved.items():
            _restore(name, previous)


value = one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
shown = value.replace("\n", " / ")
print("VALUE " + shown)
print(f"MS {statistics.median(elapsed):.17g}")
